matterFlagRules.message: A written estimate of the fee must be given to the applicant before the fee is charged. If the eventual fee will exceed the estimate, a further written estimate is required.
Respond within 30 days. If that is not possible, notify the applicant in writing of the time by which a response will be provided.
The fee must be reasonable and must not be used to discourage the applicant from pursuing the request. The Commission may review the reasonableness of the fee.

requestorNoticeTemplate: UNAUTHORED — counsel must author the requestor-facing fee notice for this jurisdiction before this pack can reach ACTIVE.
openQuestions: Whether staff time is being costed at incremental cost or at a loaded charge-out rate. A loaded rate with a profit element is not defensible.
Whether any element of the claim relates to assessing exceptions rather than providing access.

Product owner confirmed: retain as printed in §7.6's table — no condition.

RESOLVED 2026-09-17: SG-PDPA.OTHER_UNCLASSIFIED's basis is composed from two PRD sources (§7.5's OTHER_UNCLASSIFIED sentence structure and §7.6's reg. 7 operative limb) rather than quoted from one, since §7.6 prints no basis for this rule while requiring it to exist as FLAG (AC-19). Product owner confirmed: retain the composed wording as written — 'Uncategorised cost. Counsel to determine whether it is a service provided to the applicant to enable the organisation to respond.'
